authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FC-REDACT tier-1 and tier-2 input classes from doctor-contract.v4. It does not author secret bytes. It does not author a credential value. It does not author an absolute path. It does not author report bytes. It does not invent a hash-as-oracle. It does not quietly mask the high-entropy case. It does not execute FC-REDACT. It does not close OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-114. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING at FC-REDACT without inventing secret bytes or report goldens. doctor v4 exactByteIntent names three tier-1 inputs and seven tier-2 inputs. This catalog records those named classes. The high-entropy-unmasked case is named as the class's centre of gravity and is not treated as authored.

doctorV4.fcRedactExactByteIntent: A corpus of pinned INPUT bytes, each paired with the pinned doctor report bytes it produces. Tier-1 inputs: a resolved configuration carrying a secret-classified value at a known byte offset; a declared credential environment variable set to a known value; a project at a known absolute path. Tier-2 inputs: a component fault string containing a URL with userinfo, a Bearer token, an inline key=value assignment, an ANSI CSI sequence, a C0 control run, a 10 MB single-line string, and a high-entropy string in NO known credential shape.

g12v2.role: Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed. Not applied. Not withdrawn. EV-3 names FC-REDACT including the high-entropy-unmasked bound.
